title: contacts: ContactCard/copy replies copied/notCopied
description: RFC 8620 §5.4 /copy response arguments are 'created' and 'notCreated'. handle_contact_card_copy (crate-jmap-contacts-server/src/card.rs, the resp json! after the create loop) emits 'copied' and 'notCopied' instead, while its doc comment and every sibling /copy (Email, CalendarEvent, Task, FileNode) use created/notCreated. A conforming client sees no created ids. Fix: rename the two response keys and update the contacts tests that read copied/notCopied. Discovered in JMAP-s4kp.9 (not changed there, out of scope).
